title: Identical rendered lettering failures do not pay repeatedly for different frame moods
steps: Run deterministic picture looker tests with generated pixels and a scripted provider.
expect: Three concurrent identical renders with different moods make one paid provider call and retain failure.
Reused negative evidence references the original look and carries no inherited alt, subject fault or extra paid cost.
Passes and other failures remain specific to their questions.
Changed source pixels, display, surface, model or prompt require a new provider look.
Controlled provider delays report model calls, service time and wall time separately.
A missing original paid look invalidates derived evidence and requires a fresh provider call.
An exact historical paid rejection can seed the versioned proof without rewriting its answer.
fence: Exact rendered lettering rejection only; no asset blacklist, quality threshold change or reused pass.

tests: identical rendered lettering failures share one paid look across moods and concurrent calls without sharing alts
passes and subject-dependent failures never share verdicts across questions
changed pixels, display, surface, model and prompt require their own look
controlled provider delays report call, service and wall time separately for repeated versus distinct renders
a missing original paid look invalidates its derived negative proof
an exact historical lettering look seeds a versioned proof without rewriting its paid answer
